tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The terminal ground behind every screen. Rowbly never paints it in a real terminal (the user's background shows); previews paint it so the other tokens can be judged. ANSI: default background.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Fill of every Modal (generic and screen) and the Help overlay, one step off the ground so the screen behind reads as behind. Was MODAL_BACKGROUND #202028. ANSI: none (no fill).

tokens.name: overlay-raised
tokens.usage: The header band of a screen Modal (StoryModal, SettingsModal): the Story Key, name and summary line, or the settings section title. Every text token stays ≥4.5:1 on it in both themes (ink-faint 4.8:1 dark, 5.2:1 light). ANSI: none (no fill).

tokens.name: keycap
tokens.usage: Fill of a key cap: the key of any Button (header controls, a sidebar's + New … foot), drawn as the key with one column of fill each side (` n `). Text on it is ink-muted (5.4:1 dark, 5.7:1 light) or accent on the primary Button (6.0:1 dark, 4.5:1 light). ANSI: none; fall back to [n] brackets.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Fill of a Form input that is not in focus. Was INPUT_BACKGROUND #30303c. ANSI: none; the field's › marker carries focus.

tokens.name: field-focus
tokens.usage: Fill of the Form input in focus. Was FOCUSED_BACKGROUND #3a3a52. ANSI: none.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Fill of the highlighted row or Story in the region in focus: sidebar rows, settings sections, list rows, the selected Story on the Board. Always paired with the ▌ bar in accent. ANSI: inverse is NOT used; the bar alone marks it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: Story names, values, the highlighted row. 15:1 on ground, 10:1 on selection and field-focus in both themes. ANSI: default foreground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels in a Detail view (Stage, Priority…), unfocused panel titles, header detail, Story counts. ≥5:1 on ground, overlay, field and selection in both themes. ANSI: white (dark) / bright black (light).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: key-hint descriptions, placeholders, `—` empty values, `↓ 3 more`, empty-Stage text. ≥4.5:1 on ground, overlay and field in both themes; not on selection. Replaces Ink's dimColor, which terminals render inconsistently. ANSI: bright black.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline frame of a panel or Story that is NOT in focus, and the rule under a Stage name. Decorative: it never carries meaning on its own (focus is accent). ANSI: bright black.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: The | separators between header Buttons and the / in the ViewSwitch. ≥3:1 on ground in both themes. ANSI: bright black.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: FOCUS, and only focus: the border and title of the panel in focus, the ▌ selection bar, the heavy rule under the Stage in focus, the field marker ›, the primary header Button label (+ New Story). Also Story Keys. 8:1 (dark) and 5.4:1 (light) on ground. ANSI: cyan.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill: the selected Tab. 8:1 dark, 5.8:1 light. ANSI: black.

tokens.name: stage-backlog
tokens.usage: Stage Category backlog: the ● dot and the Stage name. ≥4.6:1 on every ground. ANSI: bright black (was pc.dim).

tokens.name: stage-board
tokens.usage: Stage Category board (work in flight): the ● dot and the Stage name. Also the warning Toast. ANSI: yellow.

tokens.name: stage-done
tokens.usage: Stage Category done: the ● dot and the Stage name. Close to stage-board in lightness, so it always travels with the Stage name: colour is never the only signal. ANSI: green.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors: error Toasts, Form validation, the confirm key in a delete ConfirmDialog, doctor errors. Always with a word (error, delete). ANSI: red.

tokens.name: epic
tokens.usage: The Epics Plugin's ◆ glyph on a Story and in the Epics sidebar. Only the glyph; the Epic name stays ink-muted. ANSI: magenta.

styles.name: cell-title
styles.usage: Bold: Story names in Detail headers, Stage names in list view, the Board name in the header, the panel title in focus.

styles.name: cell-body
styles.usage: Regular: everything else. A terminal has one size; hierarchy comes from weight and the ink tokens, never from size.

styles.name: cell-key
styles.usage: The key in a key hint, in ink; its description follows in cell-hint.

styles.name: cell-hint
styles.usage: Key-hint descriptions and placeholders, in ink-faint.

tokens.name: col-1
tokens.usage: 1 column: padding inside a panel (paddingX={1}), the gap between a glyph and its text, between Tabs.

tokens.name: col-2
tokens.usage: 2 columns: the gutter between Stage columns and between header groups (columnGap={2}); between key hints in the footer.

tokens.name: row-1
tokens.usage: 1 row: the gap between Stories in a Stage, between a Detail header and its Tabs, between Form fields.

tokens.name: row-2
tokens.usage: 2 rows: the space above a Modal's key-hint strip; the most Rowbly ever leaves blank.

tokens.name: border-single
tokens.usage: Ink borderStyle="single" (┌─┐): rules and the Detail view's inner frames only.

tokens.name: border-round
tokens.usage: Ink borderStyle="round" (╭─╮): every Panel, Modal, Button and Story. The default frame.
